title: Dataset Suitability and Intermittent Event Detection Audit

confirmed_evaluation_defects.name: Irregular Sampling Event Duration Multiplier Error
confirmed_evaluation_defects.description: Event duration was computed as sample_count * dt_0, where dt_0 was inferred solely from (index[1] - index[0]). In REFIT, intervals vary from 1s to 15s. This caused duration estimation errors of up to -30.78 hours (-15.9%) on Event #2, -9.51 hours (-28.6%) on Event #3, and +20.8% on Event #11.
confirmed_evaluation_defects.correction: Refactored extract_events to compute duration from true timestamp boundary intervals.

confirmed_evaluation_defects.name: Split-Boundary Crossing False Onset Fabrication
confirmed_evaluation_defects.description: When a test partition slice begins while an appliance was already running continuously in validation, extract_events prepended index 0 to start_indices. This fabricated a false onset at t=0 of the test partition, which matched the model's initial ON prediction and falsely awarded 1 True Positive onset. In reality, zero onsets occurred at t=0, and the model achieved 0 true onset detections in test.
confirmed_evaluation_defects.correction: Added initial_state_on flag to extract_events and exclude_boundary_onsets option to match_events, properly isolating ongoing activations from genuine onsets.

confirmed_evaluation_defects.name: Unmasked Event Extraction Over Missing Ground-Truth Intervals
confirmed_evaluation_defects.description: Event extraction was executed over the raw unmasked test Series, meaning candidate predictions during sensor dropouts (Issues == 1) were automatically counted as False Positives rather than isolated as unverified intervals.
confirmed_evaluation_defects.correction: Documented impact; isolated 40,429 invalid test samples (3.75%) from verified operational scoring.

confirmed_evaluation_defects.name: Sample-Level Prevalence Fallacy
confirmed_evaluation_defects.description: Reported sample F1 score of 0.9933 was driven by 99.36% positive class prevalence in test (continuous spring/summer pond aeration). Specificity was only 0.0318 (211/6,630 true negatives), meaning the model failed to detect 96.8% of OFF periods. Operational event F1 is 0.0005 with 33.66 false alarms per day.
confirmed_evaluation_defects.correction: Reconciled confusion matrix and explicitly declared REFIT pond pump untrustworthy for intermittent onset disaggregation.

label_threshold_sensitivity.conclusion: Sample count is exceptionally stable (only 1 sample difference between 15W and 20W across 5.38M readings; 37 samples between 20W and 35W). Event count varies from 57 to 96 due to minor voltage sags dipping below 25W during long runs. 20W remains scientifically sound.

candidate_dataset_inventory.name: REFIT
candidate_dataset_inventory.channels: Mains Aggregate + 9 IAM submeters per house

target_appliances_present.heater: Houses 1, 9, 16 (Electric Space Heaters, 1-2 kW; not 140 W water heater)
target_appliances_present.fan: House 2 Appliance 9 (Overhead Fan; unverified continuous usage)

candidate_dataset_inventory.intermittent_cycle_suitability: POOR (Pond pump runs continuously 24/7 for months; only 13 events across 110 days in test; 0 verified onsets detected)

candidate_dataset_inventory.sampling_rate: 1 Hz (Schneider EM6400 Mains), 1/6 Hz (CurrentCost Submeters, uniform 6.0s)

target_appliances_present.heater: Meter 4 & 5 (Geysers, 2 kW; not 140 W water heater)
target_appliances_present.fan: Meters 6, 8, 10 (Ceiling fans, unmetered or low-resolution submetering)

recommended_next_experiment.rationale: iAWE Meter 12 contains a genuine domestic overhead-tank water pump with repeated daily switching cycles (1-3 cycles per day, 15-45 minutes per cycle), authentic ON and OFF periods across train, validation, and test splits, and realistic Indian household concurrent loads. It requires ZERO new downloads (427.8 MB file already exists locally).
recommended_next_experiment.evaluation_protocol: Apply the corrected evaluate_events.py with strict onset tolerance (+/- 60s), true timestamp elapsed duration, and split-boundary onset isolation. Evaluate sample-level precision, recall, specificity, F1, and event-level precision, recall, F1, and false alarm rate per day.
recommended_next_experiment.scientific_caveat: The iAWE pump draws ~800 W, which is higher than Energy Mirror's simulated 75 W target. It validates intermittent motor batch detection, but cannot claim validation of low-power 75 W pumps without scaling analysis.
